name: granttap
description: Pair local coding agents with GrantTap and approve, answer, or steer their work from iPhone and Apple Watch.

interface.longDescription: Try now / Connect GrantTap opens the connection card. It shows linked phones and a one-time QR under Add a device, Add another device, or Reconnect. Scan that QR in GrantTap on iPhone or iPad. Codex Connected accounts is for external apps; no GrantTap account is required. Authenticate opens granttap.com/connect for coding-app approval, not the QR. Pairing stays out of chat.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer is connected to GrantTap.
